corpusReconciliation.note: Captured baseline has no inventory checksum; additions cannot be identified exactly from aggregate totals.

metricDefinitions.firstObservedWindow: First observed top-level request input; entry proxy, not causal restart cost.
metricDefinitions.observedExecutorIterationPeak: Maximum input+cacheRead+cacheCreation within observed type=message iterations; excludes advisor iterations. A lower bound where some requests lack breakdown.
metricDefinitions.peak: Maximum top-level input+cacheRead+cacheCreation per message.id. Matches captured baseline; may sum executor iterations, so not always one context window.

policyDecision.conductor: 150000 rounds above observed p90 127383; 3/49 historical conductors exceed it.
policyDecision.fieldValidation: After S3-S6, repeat topology/role/model accounting; verify stops at existing boundaries, quantify overshoot and test the target.
policyDecision.limitations: Worker and main workload/model mixes differ. Resume preparation is four opus-only worker pairs. Main/conductor restart cost is unmeasured; unknown attribution and 88 parse failures limit command-level coverage.
policyDecision.main: 200000 isolates 14/58 sessions carrying 85.954879% of main exposure, with less fragmentation than 150000 (23/58).
policyDecision.status: selected engineering policy; not automatically inferred measured limits
policyDecision.target: At most 4.33% main exposure from sessions above 200000, rounding upward the observed worker reference share 4.324947%.
policyDecision.targetStatus: project hypothesis / role-reference objective; not a causal savings prediction or an enforcement result
policyDecision.worker: 100000 rounds above observed p90 97126 and exceeds the largest observed resumption preparation window 33159 threefold.

restartCost.causalSavings: not-measured; this is observed preparation, not a warm-versus-cold treatment comparison
restartCost.limitations: Small opus-only worker sample after security-hook stops; no clean human-led or conductor restart pair was identified. Two main configurable-spec-backend sessions are contaminated by dirty mid-task work, scope changes and a model change.
restartCost.scope: Explicit worker resumes with a preceding task-check invocation for the same spec; preparation ends at first cq specs next invocation. Task-check command success is not inferred.
